selection_rule: Every landed-squash control for which the first lossless PR-member expansion and independent patch adjudication identified a narrower causal member enters this add-only ledger. No member is selected from model output alone.
generation_boundary: The refinement ledger was created only after the v3 and v5 fix-only candidate artifacts were frozen. It is evaluation input and must never be read by candidate generation, packet construction, or model prompting.
claim_boundary: These are confirmed causal atomic PR members, not four confirmed member-level AI-authorship claims. Three members carry direct AI-attribution signals; one is supported only by the AI-attributed landed squash and remains an AI-exposed PR-member control.

controls.mechanism: The member introduced the raw SSE HTTP wrapper, wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin response, and the server path without Host or Origin guards; the fix adds hostGuard and originGuard and removes the wildcard behavior.
The member introduced the Neo4j search operations that copied unvalidated group_ids into the Lucene query; the fix adds validate_group_ids at the shared search boundary.
The member replaced parameterized Neo4j label handling with direct label interpolation in node persistence queries; the fix validates node labels before those interpolated query paths execute.

The member rewrote the parser around a raw byte stream and passed bounded, non-null-terminated token slices into the legacy floating-point parser; the fix switches the active path to bounded fast_float::from_chars.
